main.title: Summary
text: Security engineer with 5 years in security operations and incident response. Experienced with SIEM tuning, detection engineering and automating responses. Interested in moving towards cloud security and Kubernetes security.

items.heading: Security Engineer — Example Energy
bullets: Wrote detection rules in Splunk and Sigma; false positives reduced by 35%.
Automated phishing triage with Python and the SOAR platform.
Led incident response for two ransomware attempts; prepared post-incident reports.

items.heading: SOC Analyst — Sample MSSP (sample)
bullets: Monitored alerts in a 24/7 SOC for 30 customers.
Analysed network traffic with Wireshark and Zeek.
Hardened Windows and Linux servers following CIS benchmarks.
